summary: Define Code DSL and normalized LSP intelligence standard

delivery.outcome: A reusable Wellmanifest Code DSL standard with a canonical Protobuf model, strict JSON projection, normalized LSP operations, deterministic conformance, and architecture guidance.
nonGoals: Implement or host an LSP gateway or language server
Replace language-specific compiler or type-checker semantics
Grant execution, CQRS, merge, or deployment authority to an LSP or LLM
Create a tag or release from an unmerged ticket branch

architecture.decision: Standardize a language-neutral Code DSL with canonical Protobuf semantics and a strict JSON projection; treat LSP 3.17 as a versioned read-only evidence binding and keep effect authority outside the standard.
interfaceChanges: Introduce wellmanifest.code/v1 as a pre-stable public semantic contract
Introduce wellmanifest.code/json/v1 as its strict JSON projection
Define the baseline normalized operation vocabulary and LSP 3.17 mapping
dataChanges: Define stable domain URI and mutable source-location separation
Require provenance and completeness on reusable semantic snapshots
architecture.rollback: Remove ticket-owned implementation paths; preserve the governed repository baseline and ticket evidence.
